data.description:
## Context
Filed from the escape analysis on marshy-chummy-coot (2399-5e49-6b28-4d59). The silently-inert primary dedup guard (bug aa7b, origin 789c) left an invariant violation visible in committed production state for the feature's entire life: .bridge_state/bindings.json showed comment_ids == 0 while bindings grew past 2,475 and outbound comment posts kept succeeding. No layer read that signal.

## Proposal (operator to adjudicate; not implemented)
Add an in-process, operation-linked invariant check to the reconciler: at end-of-pass summary (or binding-store save), if this pass successfully posted one or more outbound comments AND comment_ids gained no entries, emit a loud signal through the existing bridge_alerts machinery (already part of reduced ticket state, currently surfaced as "bridge_alerts": []).

Portability: operation-linked and in-process. It runs wherever the reconciler runs, no CI trigger, satisfying project.portability by construction.

Cost: one counter and one comparison per reconcile pass, plus the alert plumbing.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Decide whether the alert fires per-pass or debounced (e.g. only after N consecutive violating passes)
- [ ] Implement the check behind the existing bridge_alerts surface; alert text names the invariant and the pass
- [ ] A test drives a pass that posts comments while recording is disabled and asserts the alert fires; a healthy-pass test asserts it does not

## Non-goals
No new review criterion, no CI-coupled trigger (ci-gate-compat is rejected precedent), no change to the dedup guard itself (fixed in 8d98c298fa8).
data.title: Reconciler pass invariant: comment posts succeeded but comment_ids gained none
